text: Earlier this year, my office was approached by The Survivors Fund, which requested that the City of Toronto join a number of corporate sponsors in supporting their upcoming gala fundraiser event through a financial commitment. As described on their website, "the gala dinner is targeting to raise over $200,000 in net dollars to be used in 2020 to provide interest-free loans to survivors of human trafficking and/or domestic violence." According to the organizers, every interest-free loan that helps a survivor to access appropriate housing saves the City of Toronto $3,000 per month over five months - or, in other words, frees up beds in our shelter system for others who need them. Supporting the survivors of human trafficking is an established goal of City Council. The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Requested the Deputy City Manager, Community and Social Services, in consultation with relevant City divisions, to undertake an immediate review of the request from The Survivors Fund and to provide a formal response to the organization prior to their fundraising event on April 25, 2020.
